card.name: "the" in C. difficile diarrhea warning
card.fires_on: The word "the" right after "months after" in the standard warning that C. difficile-associated diarrhea can occur after antibacterial use. It fires on this one repeated sentence.

modes.label: After months, before administration
modes.description: "the" following "over two months after" and ahead of "administration of antibacterial agents" in the CDAD warning.
modes.example: CDAD has been reported to occur over two months after<< the>> administration of antibacterial agents.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it weakly favors words like "own" and "being" and disfavors "majority" and "remainder".
card.plain: It marks the word "the" in the familiar warning that C. difficile diarrhea can appear months after antibiotics.
evidence: Careful medical history is necessary since CDAD has been reported to occur over two months after<< the>> administration of antibacterial agents.
